doc.title: Ignacio Berroa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2021 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Poverty, his mother's radio and how his parents met
summary: A poor musician's family losing the TV, mother always had the radio on; parents met at a dance.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: But thanks God, we always had a radio. So my mom, she was a music fan, fanatic, and she had the radio on like in the beginning, ten, eleven AM in the morning, the radio was on and I was exposed to every type of music. Even to classical music.
Was your mother a dancer? Did she like to dance?
That’s how she met my dad, going to a place, a society popular event and just started following the orchestra where my dad used to play, and that’s how they met.
